name: sandikale-photobooth
description: SANDIKALE PHOTOBOOTH - Premium self photo studio kiosk

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main/index.js && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
